name: Via Duc Chi Ton
nameVi: Đại lễ vía Đức Chí Tôn
summary: One of the two great Cao Dai days at the Holy See in phường Long Hoa. The mountain board’s Holy See article puts it on the 9th of lunar January. The Long Hoa ward page puts it on the 8th, and says more than 30,000 people. Both days stay. The solar date and the fee are check on arrival. A 2026 hour-by-hour program was not opened.
when: The 9th of lunar January on the mountain board, and the 8th on the Long Hoa ward page. Solar date: check on arrival.
